Ready to kick-start your career in Linux & Unix support? 
 At OEDIV , part of the Oetker Group , we help mid-sized companies across Germany operate and optimize their business-critical IT environments. We are looking for a Support Engineer Linux/Unix - Service Desk (m/f/d) who is passionate about technology, troubleshooting, and delivering excellent customer support.
 What you'll do
 ✅ Provide 1st and 2nd level support for Linux and Unix-based systems
 ✅ Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents and service requests
 ✅ Monitor IT infrastructure and ensure stable system operations
 ✅ Support customers remotely and coordinate solutions with expert teams
 ✅ Document incidents, solutions, and operational procedures
 ✅ Contribute to continuous improvement of support processes and service quality
 What we're looking for
 ✔ Good knowledge of Linux and/or Unix operating systems
 ✔ Experience in IT support, system administration, or a similar technical environment
 ✔ Understanding of networking, servers, and IT infrastructure concepts
 ✔ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 ✔ Customer-oriented mindset and excellent communication skills
 ✔ German language skills (B2 or higher) and good English skills
 ✔ Independent and reliable individual who is comfortable managing responsibilities autonomously and delivering high-quality work
 Why join OEDIV?
We support your personal development by offering German language courses
Prepaid parking spaces are available for convenient and stress‑free commuting
We promote your health by offering ergonomic workstations, and a highly modern working environment with air‑conditioned offices
We ensure a barrier‑free working environment including accessible restrooms, wide corridors and doors, accessible parking spaces, a ground‑level building, and elevators
Free beverages and coffee are available throughout the working day
You benefit from a Pluxee Restaurant Pass to support your daily meals
We offer reimbursement options for fitness activities, professional training, and eyeglasses
Private Health Insurance
Annual Salary Adjustment Based on Inflation
You receive an attractive compensation package, including a 13th salary
We offer a permanent employment contract with a 40‑hour work week
You are entitled to a minimum of 20 up to 30 days of paid vacation per year
